title_en: Notice of the Supreme People's Court on Adjusting the Standards for the Jurisdiction of First-Instance Civil and Commercial Cases in Some Higher People's Courts and Intermediate People's Courts
keywords_en: Court jurisdiction over first-instance civil and commercial cases
full_text_en:
Supreme People's Court

Notice on Adjusting the Standards for the Jurisdiction of First-instance Civil and Commercial Cases by Certain High People's Courts and Intermediate People's Courts

Fa Fa [2018] No. 13

The High People's Courts of Guizhou Province, Shaanxi Province, Gansu Province, Qinghai Province, Ningxia Hui Autonomous Region, and Xinjiang Uygur Autonomous Region, and the Production and Construction Corps Branch of the High People's Court of Xinjiang Uygur Autonomous Region:

In order to meet the needs of economic and social development and civil litigation in the new era, to accurately apply the relevant provisions of the Civil Procedure Law on hierarchical jurisdiction, and to reasonably define the civil and commercial trial functions of courts at four levels, the following notice is hereby given on adjusting the standards for the jurisdiction of first-instance civil and commercial cases by certain high people's courts and intermediate people's courts:

1. First-instance civil and commercial cases where all parties have their domiciles within the provincial-level administrative region where the accepting court is located:

The High People's Courts of Guizhou Province, Shaanxi Province, and Xinjiang Uygur Autonomous Region, and the Production and Construction Corps Branch of the High People's Court of Xinjiang Uygur Autonomous Region shall have jurisdiction over first-instance civil and commercial cases with a subject matter in dispute of 300 million yuan or more. Their subordinate intermediate people's courts shall have jurisdiction over first-instance civil and commercial cases with a subject matter in dispute of 30 million yuan or more.

The High People's Courts of Gansu Province, Qinghai Province, and Ningxia Hui Autonomous Region shall have jurisdiction over first-instance civil and commercial cases with a subject matter in dispute of 200 million yuan or more. Their subordinate intermediate people's courts shall have jurisdiction over first-instance civil and commercial cases with a subject matter in dispute of 10 million yuan or more.

2. First-instance civil and commercial cases where one party has its domicile outside the provincial-level administrative region where the accepting court is located:

The High People's Courts of Guizhou Province, Shaanxi Province, and Xinjiang Uygur Autonomous Region, and the Production and Construction Corps Branch of the High People's Court of Xinjiang Uygur Autonomous Region shall have jurisdiction over first-instance civil and commercial cases with a subject matter in dispute of 100 million yuan or more. Their subordinate intermediate people's courts shall have jurisdiction over first-instance civil and commercial cases with a subject matter in dispute of 20 million yuan or more.

The High People's Courts of Gansu Province, Qinghai Province, and Ningxia Hui Autonomous Region shall have jurisdiction over first-instance civil and commercial cases with a subject matter in dispute of 50 million yuan or more. Their subordinate intermediate people's courts shall have jurisdiction over first-instance civil and commercial cases with a subject matter in dispute of 10 million yuan or more.

3. For matters not adjusted by this Notice, the provisions of the "Notice of the Supreme People's Court on Adjusting the Standards for the Jurisdiction of First-instance Civil and Commercial Cases by High People's Courts and Intermediate People's Courts" (Fa Fa [2015] No. 7) shall apply.

This Notice shall come into effect on August 1, 2018. Any problems encountered during implementation shall be promptly reported to this Court.

July 17, 2018
